input.goal: Build a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo with a software 3D renderer (no WebGL, no libraries) drawn with Canvas 2D on a full-viewport <canvas id="c">. Files: index.html, scene.js, engine3d.js, app.js (plain scripts loaded in that order, no modules, no network).
constraints: engine3d.js: vector/matrix math, perspective projection, back-face culling, painter's algorithm depth sort of triangles, flat shading with a directional light plus emissive neon colour per face.
Canvas #c fills the viewport (position fixed, inset 0) and resizes with the window, using devicePixelRatio.
Background: dark radial-gradient space, centre #1a0b2e fading to #05010d at the edges, drawn each frame.

scene.js builds: a two-tier platform (2 boxes), twin pillars (2 boxes), a lintel across the pillar tops (1 box), and a crown cap on the lintel (1 box) = 6 boxes = 36 box faces (6 faces each, each face 2 triangles). Box colours dark #1b1035 with neon edge lines in #00f0ff.
Six octahedral crystals (8 triangles each = 48 triangles) orbit the portal at different heights, each spinning; colours alternate #ff2bd6 and #00f0ff.
Portal core between the pillars: glowing radial disc (#ff2bd6 to #7a00ff) plus two concentric neon rings rotating in opposite directions (outer #00f0ff, inner #ff2bd6), drawn with shadowBlur glow.
Cyber grid floor: perspective-projected grid lines in #7a00ff with alpha fading with distance.
Exactly 180 stars in the background with twinkling alpha (sin of time with per-star phase).
Exactly 110 particles rising from the platform toward the portal, respawning at the bottom when they reach max height; colours #00f0ff/#ff2bd6, additive-looking glow.
Camera orbits the scene around the Y axis at radius ~14, slight up-down bob, looking at the portal centre.

HUD: glassmorphism panel top-left (background rgba(20,10,40,0.35), backdrop-filter blur(12px), 1px border rgba(0,240,255,0.35), border-radius 14px, white text, font system-ui) with title text exactly 'NEON PORTAL 3D' in element #title, and stats elements #fps, #polys, #parts showing 'FPS: n', 'POLYS: n', 'PARTS: n'.

Buttons: #pause (text 'Pause', becomes 'Resume' when paused), #orbit (text 'Orbit ON', toggles to 'Orbit OFF'), #reset (text 'Reset': resets time, camera angle, speed to 1, unpauses, orbit ON). Slider <input type=range id=speed min=0 max=3 step=0.1 value=1>.

window.app object with fields: paused (bool), orbit (bool), speed (number), time (number, advances by dt*speed when not paused), camAngle (number, advances only when orbit on and not paused), stars (array, length 180), particles (array, length 110), crystals (array, length 6), boxFaces (number = 36), crystalTris (number = 48), polys (number of triangles drawn last frame), fps (number).
Pause stops all animation (time and camAngle frozen); slider input sets app.speed.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"#c"},{"text":"#title","match":"NEON PORTAL 3D"},{"wait":500},{"js":"app.stars.length===180 && app.particles.length===110 && app.crystals.length===6 && app.boxFaces===36 && app.crystalTris===48"},{"js":"app.polys>0 && /POLYS: \\d+/.test(document.querySelector('#polys').textContent) && /FPS: \\d+/.test(document.querySelector('#fps').textContent) && /PARTS: 110/.test(document.querySelector('#parts').textContent)"},{"expect":"moving"},{"click":"#pause"},{"js":"app.paused===true && document.querySelector('#pause').textContent.includes('Resume')"},{"js":"(()=>{const t=app.time;return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(app.time===t),300))})()"},{"click":"#pause"},{"click":"#orbit"},{"js":"app.orbit===false && document.querySelector('#orbit').textContent.includes('OFF')"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"js":"Math.abs(app.speed-2.5)<1e-6"},{"click":"#reset"},{"js":"app.orbit===true && app.speed===1 && app.paused===false && document.querySelector('#orbit').textContent.includes('ON')"},{"js":"getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#c')).position==='fixed'"}]}

content.text: I had Tandem build the demo, and it passed every check on the second try. The first run got stuck without fixing anything, so I sent it one hint and it fixed the problem. It's split into four files: `index.html`, `scene.js`, `engine3d.js` and `app.js`. Open `index.html` to see the portal scene, the orbiting camera and the HUD with the Pause, Orbit and Reset buttons and the speed slider. The checks covered the object counts, the HUD readouts, the buttons and slider, and that the scene is animating. They didn't check how it looks, so open the page to judge the finish yourself.
